unpublished_reason: The required speaker-vad-turn mode is waived again: its target-speaker fixture cannot be rebuilt on this host (the host sherpa-onnx binary that generates the text assertions is unavailable; the legacy build lacks libonnxruntime.1.24.4.dylib and the current derived tree has no host build). This revision does not touch the owner-recognition code (Runtime.ets changes are limited to the silence-filler gate) and 0.3.26 ran the mode with all 6 attribution assertions passing. Delivery policy requires the checked reports to PASS, so the package stays an unpublished candidate, deliverable with the disclosed waiver under the user's explicit authorization, as 0.3.26 was. The release branch is not yet merged to main.
baseline: The customer's actual 0.3.26 (source 927bda6e, complete ZIP 860d731f…), delivered with the speaker-vad-turn waiver; the ledger still lists 0.3.26 as published:false.
language_scope: ZH_EN only; no yue-en models; TTS models not included; target-speaker enhancement interface only, not enablable.
product_changes: 1) Speaker attribution is now decided by voiceprint identity, on by default: Sortformer only answers 'when does someone speak', identity comes from a CAM++ embedding of the first 3 s of each turn matched against per-session incremental centroids (merge threshold 0.50, otherwise a new identity up to maxSpeakers). New SpeakerDiarizationConfig.speakerIdentityMode ('voiceprint' default | 'model' = 0.3.26 behaviour) and SpeakerTurn.modelSpeakerIndex. Measured: the customer's 4 field recordings 34/34 leave-one-out attribution (0.3.26 chain 28/34); 4 of the 6 on-device 'speakers in turn' ticket cases fixed, the remaining 2 explained by speaker self-similarity 0.546/0.523 above 0.50; the 0.50 threshold has 0.346% combined error on 25 real meeting speakers / 300 real segments (0.45: 1.211%). 2) Silence is no longer transcribed as 嗯: non-empty text now needs acoustic evidence independent of the recogniser (a confirmed run above the -74 dBFS publish threshold or a native-VAD-confirmed run). The customer's 52.2 s near-silence file is dropped; 90 customer far-field segments and 500 public utterances lose 0 results; on-device A/B with and without the fix is character-identical (the phenomenon does not reproduce on the device, so the device only shows no regression). Both changes are mirrored on Android in source; Android is not rebuilt in this delivery.

thermal_long_run: MEASURED before the freeze on the same device with ASR + diarization + voiceprint identity: 143.8 min, net self-heating +2.2 C after ambient correction, slope +0.22 C/h after 70 min (thermal plateau), no throttling; RSS saturating around 805 MB after ~90 min, HWM 1044 MB; voiceprint path adds about +39 MB HWM with the 3 s embedding cap (+141 MB without). No 'model'-mode control arm, so the voiceprint increment in heat is not isolated. See docs/speaker/DEVICE_2H_THERMAL_MEMORY_20261103.md.
diarization_accuracy: Scenario evaluation (docs/speaker/DIARIZATION_SCENARIO_EVAL_20261103.md, customer version 角色分离场景测评报告-客户版-20261103.md): on 28 real AliMeeting sessions (2-4 speakers) the new chain scores DER 10.1% against 29.2% for the old Community-1 chain on the same audio, better in 28/28 sessions; far-field costs +1.8 pp; 3-speaker sessions over-report a 4th speaker in 3 of 5; 5+ speakers tie with the old chain (46.7 vs 46.8); the customer's 111223-816 recording still shows ~22% confusion. An earlier AISHELL-3 synthetic conclusion was retracted (300x confusion inflation vs real speakers at matched similarity).
